source_snapshot_visible_interpretation: Recognizable blue wreck wall/rail segment, dominated by large straight horizontal blue surfaces and two narrow dark vertical reinforcing ribs.
The two ribs carry dark rectangular front plates, each with two tiny pale rivets. Rear/upward rib ends are also visible.
Broad surface color is saturated cyan/royal blue; front and lower bands are dark navy. The surfaces are visually flat, with little rounded edge response, grain or purposeful damage.
Small rivets and thin edge seams carry much less visual weight than the large blue planes. The silhouette is highly rectangular.
fixed_target_visible_interpretation: The target keeps the blue wreck-section identity and paired vertical straps, while turning the broad form into chunky layered blue timbers with a dark continuous horizontal reinforcing band.
Top/front edges are rounded and softly uneven; a few purposeful chips and split/notched timber contours give wear without destroying the main rectangular modular reading.
Large calm blue value areas remain readable, with a few shallow flowing grain lines, cyan upper-edge light, golden warm corner glints, and deeper blue recessed gaps.
The iron reads as thick rounded navy metal with broad soft highlights; larger faceted pale rivets and plate edges separate clearly from the wood.

Visible target changes to timber layering, band construction, rib/plate proportions and rivet count are aesthetic design opportunities, subject to the later frozen functional contract. This image alone cannot establish valid joins or registration.
warm_soft_reference_visible_interpretati: The reference combines strong clear color blocks with faceted surfaces and rounded material edges, soft shadow gradients and bright warm edge highlights.

Useful transfer to the blue wreck is lighting softness, edge thickness, clean volume/value separation and restrained warm highlights; the green/orange subject palette is not itself a requested wreck recolor.
